exactWording.ru: От него требуют признать выдумкой собственную миссию.
exactWording.en: He is pressed to deny his own mission.

findings.defect: The claimed evidence establishes drugged interrogation and missing memory, not this particular demand. The Chapter 13 guide explicitly distinguishes what Genly remembers from what he assumes. Giving the interrogators a specific demand converts the narrator's knowledge gap into an asserted event. This is not a claim that the demand cannot occur anywhere in the unread edition; it is unsupported by the checked sources offered for this screen.

smallestCorrection.en: Delete “He is pressed to deny his own mission.” Keep the arrest, drugs, gaps in memory and transport.

The Story: prison/transport and farm paragraphs

exactWording.ru: одежда и тела становятся единственным укрытием.
exactWording.en: clothing and bodies are their shelter.

findings.defect: Clothing is added as part of the truck's survival mechanism. The checked guide explicitly places Genly naked in the truck and describes huddling for warmth; its provision of clothing/bedding belongs to the later farm. It supplies no basis for this garment shelter. Do not broaden that observation into a claim here about the exact condition of every prisoner.

smallestCorrection.ru: Удалить «одежда и»: «Заключённые жмутся друг к другу, пытаясь сохранить тепло; тела становятся единственным укрытием.» Можно просто закончить фразу после «тепло».
smallestCorrection.en: Delete “clothing and”: “Prisoners huddle together for warmth; their bodies are their shelter.” Ending the sentence after “warmth” is sufficient.

exactWording.ru: В Пулефене заставляют работать и дают средства, подавляющие кеммер. Для Генли препараты особенно опасны.
exactWording.en: Pulefen means forced work and drugs that suppress kemmer. The substances are particularly dangerous to Genly.

findings.defect: The second sentence refers directly to the kemmer suppressants just introduced. The checked accounts instead connect Genly's worsening illness and memory haze to repeated drug-assisted interrogations. The prose merges two treatments and gives an unverified biological cause for the illness that makes rescue necessary.

smallestCorrection.ru: «В Пулефене заставляют работать и подавляют кеммер препаратами. Генли снова подвергают допросам с инъекциями; после каждого ему всё хуже.» Затем сохранить Асра и невозможность выбраться самому.
smallestCorrection.en: “Pulefen means forced work and drugs that suppress kemmer. Genly is also repeatedly drugged for interrogation, and grows sicker after each session.” Then retain Asra and his inability to escape.

exactWording.ru: Разговор становится прямее; прежняя предполагаемая насмешка оказывается серьёзностью.

findings.defect: This sentence is supportable, but it is the only explanation offered at the reconciliation point. The full retained route never lets Estraven explain the apparent withdrawal at court or his aim for Gethen regardless of which country first joins. The opening's central political misunderstanding therefore remains unresolved: an inscrutable minister becomes a caring companion without the character's stated political purpose. The second audience says Genly defends him, but also omits the substance of that defence. This is a meaning/causality omission, not a demand to restore all political subplots or to give Estraven a single private motive.

smallestCorrection.ru: В сцене после спасения кратко передать объяснение Эстравена: «Эстравен объясняет, что хотел уберечь миссию от своей опалы. Он добивается союза Гетена с Экуменой, какая бы страна ни вступила первой.» Сохранить личную близость и дальнейшую неопределённость; добавить source 24 (guide Chapter 14) к изменённому экрану.
smallestCorrection.en: At the post-rescue conversation, briefly attribute Estraven's explanation: “Estraven explains that he wanted to keep his disgrace from harming the mission. He wants Gethen to join the Ekumen, whichever country comes first.” Retain personal attachment and later uncertainty; add source 24 (guide Chapter 14) to the revised screen.

narrativeAssessment.coreStory: Concrete ceremonial, supper, hospitality, camp, rescue and ice scenes carry the revised story. Genly's prejudiced categories, gradual closeness, and incomplete understanding remain part of the narrative.
narrativeAssessment.remainingMeaningIssue: The political explanation of Estraven's apparent betrayal and world-level allegiance needs the small attributed restoration in LHD-SR-004.
narrativeAssessment.shallowRoutes: Both modes coherently stop at the hospitality/faction warning, before arrest. Essential omits exile logistics without stranding an undefined character; Core restores them. The foretelling answer is explicitly deferred, with a marked flashback in Deep.
narrativeAssessment.storyMythFrame: Estraven's diary perspective survives in the news screen. Embedded legends, much religious history and full kinship/vow background are omitted and disclosed. The Chapter 9 names are not conflated with the contemporary characters. Acceptable as a selected main-arc condensation, not a representation of the novel's complete polyphonic form.
narrativeAssessment.ending: Sassinoth transmission preparation precedes renewed flight; border loss precedes recovery/audience, crew arrival and family visit. No claim that every nation has already consented, Estraven's name is cleared, or his intention is certain.
narrativeAssessment.parity: No independent substantive RU/EN divergence found; required defects are shared. RU's less explicit description of Ashe and EN's 'former partner' remain compatible.

spoilerAssessment.limits: Static inspection plus exact corpus checks; no new browser, fresh consent interaction or physical iPhone verification. Existing behavior uses Deep selection and an in-sequence warning; no new separate hard consent gate is claimed.

optionalTaste.note: Some short beats remain synopsis-like. If polishing further, a source-backed comic exchange (the actual rocket/firecracker confusion in Chapter 10, or Asra's question in guide 13) could add humour without any modern moral, invented dialogue or fixed screen quota.
The shared final is safe but generic after Estre. Its cadence could be quieter; do not let polishing replace Sorve's question with an editorial takeaway.
